title: The cat-and-mouse game over 3D-printed guns has begun
summary: Wilson’s company, Defense Distributed, runs DEFCAD , the world’s largest 3D gun file repository, which he says hosts over 200,000 files of gun designs and components, such as suppressors. Wilson isn’t new when it comes to picking fights over 3D-printed gun laws.
